title: Joshua Tree NP Fire Severity & Vegetation
description: Burn severity rasters for the 2025 Eureka and Black Rock fires in Joshua Tree National Park, together with the park-wide NPS vegetation map. Supports the post-fire reporting questions NPS asks after a burn: how much area burned, in which vegetation types, at what severity, and how much of it had burned before. Historical fire perimeters are not included here — use the CAL FIRE collections in the public catalog (calfire-2025-firep), which already contain both 2025 fires and every prior perimeter in the park.

providers.name: Schmidt Center for Data Science & Environment, UC Berkeley

eureka-rbr.title: Eureka Fire — Relativized Burn Ratio (RBR)
eureka-rbr.description: Relativized Burn Ratio for the Eureka Fire (2025-05), 92x81 pixels at roughly 15 m, 3,835 valid pixels, observed range -0.220 to 0.502, nodata -9999. RBR = dNBR / (NBR_prefire + 1.001) after Parks, Dillon & Miller (2014). Higher is more severe; values at or below 0 indicate no detected change. Produced by the Schmidt DSE Fire Severity Tool.

black-rock-rbr.title: Black Rock Fire — Relativized Burn Ratio (RBR)
black-rock-rbr.description: Relativized Burn Ratio for the Black Rock Fire (2025-10), 57x47 pixels at roughly 15 m, 1,138 valid pixels, observed range -0.109 to 0.229, nodata -9999. RBR = dNBR / (NBR_prefire + 1.001) after Parks, Dillon & Miller (2014). Higher is more severe; values at or below 0 indicate no detected change. Produced by the Schmidt DSE Fire Severity Tool.

vegetation-pmtiles.title: JOTR Vegetation Map (PMTiles)
vegetation-pmtiles.description: 16,499 vegetation polygons, zoom 6-14, for map display.

table:columns.name: MapUnit_Name
table:columns.description: Vegetation map unit name, e.g. 'Singleleaf Pinyon / Muller Oak Woodland Association'. 67 distinct units across the park. This is the column to group by for vegetation breakdowns.

vegetation-parquet.title: JOTR Vegetation Map (GeoParquet)
vegetation-parquet.description: DuckDB-native GeoParquet, 16,499 polygons covering 320,788 ha, 67 map units, POLYGON/MULTIPOLYGON in WGS84 (OGC:CRS84). Vegetation Mapping Inventory Project for Joshua Tree NP (NPS). Coordinates are snapped to a 1e-6 degree (~0.1 m) grid to reduce file size; this is far below the mapping accuracy of the source and does not change reported areas.
